prompts.hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art website hero background illustration for a Korean university taxi-sharing app, wide landscape 1536x1024 composition. Original premium 16-bit cozy pixel art, crisp square pixel clusters and limited palette, NO anti-aliasing, NO blurry gradients. A tranquil small Korean university campus on a green hill on a clear spring morning: central cream academic building with a muted jade roof and blue windows, simple campus gate, dark evergreen and mint leafy trees, tiny flowering bushes, stairs, a winding cream path. Small commuter station shelter toward left. Across the lower quarter a horizontal dark green-gray road with pale lane marks, intentionally empty and uncluttered so a separate taxi sprite can be overlaid. The campus is illustrative, not an accurate architectural depiction of any real school. Clear silhouettes, charming game environment, generous pale mint sky with two pixel clouds, scene fits fully within canvas with no cut off building. Palette ivory #fff8e8, mint #e8f4df, evergreen #175b43, jade #31846a, butter yellow #f3c958, sky teal #92c8c0, small coral accents. Bright calm and inviting, legible at small size. No text, no letters, no signs with writing, no logos, no cars, no human figures, no watermark. Not isometric 3D render; handcrafted side-view pixel illustration with slight top view of ground.
prompts.taxi: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original pixel art mascot sprite for the Korean campus taxi sharing web app, on a truly transparent background with alpha. A cute compact butter-yellow taxi facing RIGHT in strict side view, sturdy dark evergreen outlines, two black square wheels with cream hubs, mint windows, simple white roof taxi light with tiny dark checker blocks (NO lettering), an ivory side stripe and a small green leaf emblem on the door. Two tiny backpack shapes just visible behind windows to suggest a campus trip, no human faces or eyes on car. The one taxi is centered, filling 82% of the square canvas horizontally with generous vertical transparent margins. Crisp square pixel clusters as if drawn on a 96x64 pixel grid and nearest-neighbor enlarged; sophisticated cohesive 16-bit pixel art, exact hard edges, minimal flat 3-tone shading. Palette butter yellow #f3c958, pale cream #fff8e8, evergreen #175b43, jade #31846a, light mint #d9efd9, dark teal #173b36. Tiny short ground shadow made of hard edged dark translucent pixels immediately below wheels only. One single car, isolated, no scene, no additional objects, no text, no lettering, no signature, no watermark, no sticker border, no blur, no checkerboard background. The wheels share a horizontal baseline, silhouette readable when reduced to 48 pixels wide.
prompts.taxi_cleanup: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied taxi mascot PNG. Keep the identical yellow taxi design, direction facing right, leaf door emblem, roof sign, windows, luggage silhouettes, wheels and colors. THE ONLY CHANGE: clean the transparent cutout and pixel finish. Remove ALL the diffuse green glow/halo around the taxi and ALL soft shadows, gradients, vignettes, dark background effects. Outside the taxi's hard stepped outline every pixel must be truly fully transparent (alpha 0). Within the taxi use opaque flat colors and hard pixel steps, remove semitransparent glow. Keep full taxi centered on a transparent landscape canvas, with a modest 8 percent blank margin. Do not add any object, text, shadow or background. This is an in-game pixel sprite that must sit cleanly on a pale cream webpage, so absolutely no glow or feathered dark edges.
